description.zh: 在无摩擦、有摩擦和斜面上推箱子，用频闪残影看加速度如何由合力与质量决定；再用相互推开的小车和电梯里的秤检验第三定律与 N=m(g+a)。质点、恒定质量、g=9.8 的简化模型。
description.en: Push a box on ice, a rough floor and a ramp and see in stroboscopic ghosts how acceleration comes from net force and mass; then test the third law with two carts and N = m(g+a) with a lift scale. A point-mass, constant-mass, g = 9.8 model.

reason.zh: 第 2 步让摩擦吃掉部分推力，只有剩下的合力才产生加速度，这正是 net-force 节点的核心。
reason.en: Step 2 lets friction eat part of the push so only the remaining net force accelerates the box, which is the core of the net-force node.

label.zh: 加速度是速度的变化率
label.en: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity

reason.zh: 第 0 步把加速度当作速度每秒的变化量，频闪图里相邻残影的间距增加量就是它的直观样子。
reason.en: Step 0 treats acceleration as the change of velocity per second, and the growth of the gaps between ghosts is its visual form.

title.zh: 为什么推得越重加速越慢？
title.en: Why does a heavier box accelerate less?

note: Mechanics pages live in atlas group "waves" next to net-force and work-energy; fragment uses that group.
